data: What is the approximate value of the blue line in the year 2017?

The blue line represents the growth of the German Spoken Wikipedia resources over time. The caption states that English and German both grow with about 33 hours of additional audio per year. The y-axis shows the cumulative size in hours. The blue line reaches approximately 350 hours in the year 2017. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line in the year 2017 is 350 hours.
